image_usage: Illustrations explain pipeline architecture; all statistical charts use recorded data.

prompts.iot: Landscape scientific portfolio infographic: network flows → 42 features → XGBoost attack prediction, and local Dueling DQN across three clients → Flower / FedAvg → global RL model → Flask dashboard. Raw data stays local; only weights move. Ivory, charcoal, yellow and sage paper-cut style; no performance figures.
prompts.retinal: Landscape scientific portfolio infographic: retinal images → preprocess and split → vision models (Custom CNN, DenseNet121, ResNet50, EfficientNet-B0, MobileNetV3, ViT) → 10-class prediction → Web / API / Android. Branches for Grad-CAM++ attention heatmap and FedAvg / FedProx experiments. Ivory, charcoal, yellow and lavender paper-cut style; no performance figures. Correct heading to Vision models.
prompts.banknote: Landscape scientific portfolio infographic: banknote image → 224 x 224 RGB → MobileNetV2 → binary classifier → authentic / counterfeit → Flask interface. Training branch for augmentation and transfer learning with TensorFlow / Keras. Ivory, charcoal, yellow and sand paper-cut style; no performance figures.
